parameters.query:
WITH gate AS (
  SELECT governance.acquire_runtime_gate('scheduled_intelligence') AS reliability_gate
)
SELECT CASE
  WHEN (reliability_gate->>'allowed')::boolean
    THEN governance.build_scheduled_intelligence($1,$2::timestamptz)
  ELSE jsonb_build_object(
    'status','skipped',
    'cadence',$1,
    'as_of',$2::timestamptz,
    'reason','CIRCUIT_OPEN',
    'retry_after',reliability_gate->>'retry_after'
  )
END AS intelligence
FROM gate;
